dispositions.topic_text: Define how CLK-002 tests prove the rate limiter is the sole caller of the monotonic clock
dispositions.what: The CLK-002 witness (code-factory #189) shows that the viewer-entry rate limit is the only caller of the clock source's monotonic reading (monotonic_seconds), the same static form as CLK-001's 'no module other than the clock source reads the host clock'; the fact itself is A28's normative rule and State 3's Time convention.
